shared_elements: dense low-relief/outline patterning covering the field
justification: The only correspondence is the wholly generic presence of human figures and a repeated series of small identical motifs (stacked frontal masks with attendant faces in A, a row of vertical crew strokes above a hull in B). Everything specific differs: A is a vertically stacked, densely interlaced arrangement of plastically modelled faces, headdresses and scrolls with a naturalistic seated onlooker, while B is a pair of flat, linear, schematic boats with upturned prows and stick-crew — no shared motif, relationship or convention of depiction.
